description: What raw land costs across a region of Texas, from county appraisal district values (parcels of 5+ acres whose buildings are 20% of value or less; value divided by acres; newer appraisal roll used where available). Three modes. area: one county (county) or a point and radius (address or lat/lng, radius_mi 1 to 15): median, 25th and 75th percentile $/acre and how it compares with neighboring areas and the Texas reference. compare: 2 to 5 counties side by side. cheapest: the lowest-cost 10 km squares and counties statewide, or within near_mi of a point, with optional max_usd_per_acre and min_parcels. Use for 'what does land cost in X', 'is Y cheaper than Z', 'where is cheap land in Texas'. The tool knows nothing about water, power or fiber: for 'cheap land with good water' or 'cheap land near 345 kV', run cheapest, then water_screen, water_well_plan or nearest_substation on the squares that fit. For a single tract with asking prices and an offer range use land_value instead. Appraisals lag sale prices, and in farm and ranch counties some districts value land closer to agricultural use, so the cheapest areas can read low. Enterprise Lite and Enterprise; free and Pro get a note on what it returns.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

counties.description: 2 to 5 county names for mode compare.

county.description: Texas county name for mode area, e.g. 'Dimmit'.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Mode cheapest: how many squares, 1 to 50. Default 15.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

max_usd_per_acre.description: Mode cheapest: only squares with a median at or below this.

min_parcels.description: Mode cheapest: smallest number of raw-land parcels behind a square, 5 to 500. Default 20.

mode.description: area (default with a county or location), compare (with counties), cheapest (default otherwise).

near_mi.description: Mode cheapest: only squares within this many miles of the address or lat/lng, 10 to 300.

radius_mi.description: Radius for mode area around a location, 1 to 15 miles. Default 10.

name: regional_land_value
title: Regional land cost: appraised $/acre by county or area, comparisons, and the cheapest areas in Texas
